title: Broker or dealer
description: A single broker or dealer who arranged the transfer. organisationName and contactDetails are required, and exactly one of registrationNumber or reasonForNoRegistrationNumber must be provided. address is optional.

organisationName.description: Name of the broker or dealer organisation who arranged this transfer.

registrationNumber.description: Waste carrier, broker or dealer registration number, in a valid UK home-nation format (England and NRW CBDU/CBDL, SEPA WCR/SCO/SEA/SNO/SWE and PCT, NI ROC UT/LT). Mutually exclusive with reasonForNoRegistrationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.

reasonForNoRegistrationNumber.description: Reason no registrationNumber is held. Free text for now — enum values TBC pending BA/policy input. Mutually exclusive with registrationNumber — exactly one of the two is required.
